pr_body:
This is older than what's in Arcade now: https://github.com/dotnet/arcade/blob/eae015fb1c92ceef69126164b3969447d0355c08/eng/Versions.props#L45. dotnet/SDK uses the Arcade version, so we can just fall back to that.

Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/45882

issue_context.title: Build errors when building in source-build with the latest compiler version.
issue_context.body:
The following build errors were encountered when building aspnetcore with the latest compiler which is what source-build does.
See https://github.com/dotnet/installer/pull/15151#issuecomment-1371385658 for additional details.

```
  /repos/dotnet/src/aspnetcore/artifacts/source-build/self/src/src/SignalR/common/Shared/ClientResultsManager.cs(26,31): error CS8600: Converting null literal or possible null value to non-nullable type. [/repos/dotnet/src/aspnetcore/artifacts/source-build/self/src/src/SignalR/server/Core/src/Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR.Core.csproj]
  /repos/dotnet/src/aspnetcore/artifacts/source-build/self/src/src/SignalR/common/Shared/ClientResultsManager.cs(26,31): error CS8604: Possible null reference argument for parameter 'result' in 'void TaskCompletionSourceWithCancellation<T>.SetResult(T result)'. [/repos/dotnet/src/aspnetcore/artifacts/source-build/self/src/src/SignalR/server/Core/src/Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR.Core.csproj]
```
comments: Merged a PR earlier today which should fix this: https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/45881. @MichaelSimons please re-open if that doesn't do the trick

review_comments: CC @BrennanConroy this is to preemptively fix https://github.com/dotnet/installer/pull/15151#issuecomment-1371385658, which we'll see once we ingest the new SDK from that PR
No, `Result` is allowed to be null, the issue is using generics and nullability doesn't play nicely together.
@BrennanConroy is the current fix OK then?
Yes, unless you know a better way to annotate generics to allow nullability.
